source_verification: Values independently checked against raw run.log; brief supplied requested reference scope.

first_split_records_from_brief.interpretation: First split record as stated in brief
Second split record as stated in brief

timer_scope_notes: Raw adaptation summary reports Adapt [s] of 3819.85 and 2440.84; brief separately identifies inner native times 3640.7 and 2314.9. They are distinct scopes, retain both.
Collapse-exit phase records are a snapshot at the end of collapse; election/upper/update and geometry counters are accumulated counters, not exclusive phase durations.
The emitted record names election_seconds but does not disaggregate World and Directory election. collective_seconds is separate and is not synonymous with either election category.
No explicit other field appears in these per-rank phase records. Do not infer it by subtracting overlapping timer scopes.
Second adaptation tetra count was not present in the summary table; only final points are explicit in the inspected log.

timer_interpretation.native_inner_time: NATIVE3D_DETAIL stage=refine total; per-rank rows emitted in rank0/stdout.
timer_interpretation.directory_election: NATIVE3D_DETAIL directory_elections is call count; nested_directory_election is accumulated seconds, per rank.
timer_interpretation.world_election: Per-rank NATIVE3D_STAGE stage=exit election_calls/election_seconds provide World election calls/seconds.
timer_interpretation.upper_and_geometry: Per-rank final stage=exit rows provide upper_calls/upper_seconds and geometry trials/rejections.
timer_interpretation.update_and_other: NATIVE3D_DETAIL refine rows provide update and other.
timer_interpretation.phase_intervals: Derived with analyze_B.py intervals_for_invocation from rank-specific stdout markers; marker scopes retained, no profiler clocks.

rank_separated_source.authoritative_for: per-rank stage sequences and exits; rank0/stdout holds all NATIVE3D_DETAIL stage=refine records
rank_separated_source.adaptation_mapping: Per-rank stdout has two stage invocations; invocation 1 => adaptation 1, invocation 2 => adaptation 2. No startup adaptation 0 is included.
